prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 4 tests (up to +15.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 4 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 5 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) were helpful in 2 tests (+7.0% and +8.7%), though 2 hurt performance (-3.7% and -3.8%) and 1 showed no clear effect.
Redesigns (redesign) and step reordering (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test each (-7.5% and -3.8% respectively) and showed no clear effect in all other tests.
Copy changes, hints, notifications, and new flows showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, +3.0% vs +15.4% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Traits Audio Showcase Screen: Insert a new screen before the adoption certificate where users can play short audio clips showcasing different pet personality voices. (why: Adoption step has a median time of 89s and 74.8% completion; previewing companion audio traits increases emotional investment prior to certificate generation.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Sound Effects Preview Carousel on Waiting Screen: Add an interactive audio sample carousel on the waiting screen so users can hear companion sound effects while waiting for the engine to launch. (why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s / mean 2336s; waiting screen info features showed consistent historical gains (+5.7%).)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Desktop Voice Command Test Flow: Add an interactive voice command test widget on the home intro screen letting users test speaking or pressing hotkeys to control their pet. (why: 3 support emails report confusion about how to control or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Desktop Companion Capabilities Interactive Preview Screen: Insert a new screen after story detailing desktop pet behaviors like floating, sitting on windows, and reacting to cursor movement. (why: Choose path takes 8s median / 514s mean; introducing new screens early has historically yielded up to +15.4% conversion wins.)
4: [choose_path, reorder] Story Screen First Pathway Reorder Flow: Reorder the introductory screens to display the narrative story first before selecting the adoption path. (why: Choose path conversion drops 19.1% of users; leading with the narrative story builds context before choosing an adoption mode.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Desktop Sleep and Summon Gesture Tips on Waiting: Add desktop pet sleep, wake, and summon gesture instructions directly to the waiting screen initialization view. (why: 3 support emails report post-onboarding confusion on hiding or summoning pets; adding info during waiting captures active user attention.)
6: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Action Menu Discovery Screen: Add a final quick-action discovery screen after home intro showing how the right-click desktop pet context menu works. (why: Finish step overall conversion is 30.6% and users write support tickets about controlling and managing their desktop pet post-setup.)
7: [adoption, layout] Stage Layout for Adoption Certificate Celebration: Update adoption_certificate layout to 'stage' showcasing pet preview and official certificate badges side-by-side. (why: Adoption step drops 25.2% of users; layout improvements historically yield substantial conversion increases.)
